changelog:
elliott-wave-2 v0.1.0

- Initial release of the Elliott Wave skill.
- Supports wave counting (which wave, five-up/three-down), extension identification, and Fibonacci ratio application (38.2%, 50%, 61.8%) for retracements and targets.
- Enforces core Elliott Wave constraints: corrective waves as threes, wave 4 non-overlap, alternation, and extension identification.
- Differentiates from time-cycle and reversal-pattern methods.
- Not applicable for time-cycle or head-and-shoulders pattern analyses.
summary: 当用户要数艾略特波浪（数浪/第几浪，五浪上升/三浪下跌）、判断延长浪、用菲波纳奇比例（38.2%/50%/61.8%）测回撤与 目标，或应用 4 浪不重叠/交替规则/调整浪三浪等数浪约束时激活。 不适用于：时间周期择时（转 time-cycles）、头肩/双顶形态（转 reversal-patterns）。 关键 trigger 词：数浪、第几浪、浪型、艾略特、五浪三浪、延长浪、菲波纳奇、浪 1-5、调整浪、1.618。 Activate when the user wants to count Elliott waves (wave counting / which wave, five-up/three-down), identify extension waves, use Fibonacci ratios (38.2%/50%/61.8%) for retracement and targets, or apply counting constraints such as "wave 4 does not overlap", alternation, and "correction is three waves". Not applicable: time-cycle timing (-> time-cycles), head-and-shoulders / double-top (-> reversal-patterns). Key trigger words: wave count, Elliott, five-three waves, extension, Fibonacci, waves 1-5, corrective wave, 1.618.
